goals.name: Finish or skip setup without recording, signing in or buying
Complete listen-and-say practice without microphone or AI
F1 · Reach the first sound report (no account, ≤3 diagnostics)
F2 · Practice a sentence and raise the flagged sound on retry
F3 · Master a trouble sound via a drill (mastery rises)
F4 · Type any text, score it, and save it to the set
F5 · Start the no-card trial and get Pro
F6 · Reinstall and restore Pro + progress
F7 · Complete a daily session and increment the streak
